children: Imperial Oil Ltd. (IMO) filed a Form 8K - Regulation FD Disclosure - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on October 20, 2026.

On October 20, 2026, Imperial Oil Limited (the "company") by means of a press release advised that a third quarter earnings call will take place at 9:00 a.m. MT on October 30, 2026, following the release of the company's third quarter earnings. A copy of the press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to this report.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/49938/000004993826000045/imo-20261020.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/49938/000004993826000045/0000049938-26-000045-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
